entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Liberation and Independence, a transformative movement in Philippines (1944–1946). Emerged from Battle of Leyte Gulf — largest naval battle in history and MacArthur's famous pledge: 'I shall return'. Catalyzed Battle of Manila devastates the capital; over 100,000 Filipino civilians killed and Huk Rebellion — communist-led agrarian insurgency in Central Luzon.
